name: ens-wind-tunnel
description: ENS wind tunnel browser acquisition and control application
author: ENS Wind Tunnel Team

scripts.build: pnpm typecheck && vite build && node scripts/build-offline.cjs
scripts.format: prettier --write src tests scripts/*.cjs *.ts *.mts *.json .github/workflows/*.yml docs README.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests scripts/*.cjs *.ts *.mts *.json .github/workflows/*.yml docs README.md
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm format:check
